christ-crucified-murillo
Christ hangs on the cross against a dark sky, with his head bowed and a soft light on his body. Bartolomé Esteban Murillo painted it in about 1677.
the-heavenly-and-earthly-trinities

The baby Jesus stands between his parents, Mary and Joseph, on earth, and above them God the Father and the Holy Spirit look down. Bartolomé Esteban Murillo painted it in about 1678, and it joins the earthly and the heavenly families.
the-holy-family-with-saint-john-the-baptist-saint-eliza

Mary, Joseph, the baby Jesus, Saint Elizabeth and the young John the Baptist are gathered in a cozy family scene, with angels. Josefa de Óbidos painted it in about 1678, and she was one of the best painters in Portugal.
the-infant-christ-distributing-bread-to-the-pilgrims
A young Christ hands out bread to pilgrims, while a child looks up gratefully, and angels hold baskets. Bartolomé Esteban Murillo painted it in about 1678.
the-penitent-magdalene-comforted-by-angels
Mary Magdalene lies in a soft, glowing landscape, with angels around her, comforting her. Josefa de Óbidos painted it in about 1679.
a-ship-on-the-high-seas-caught-by-a-squall-known-as-the
A sailing ship leans over in a sudden gust, with the sea swirling and the sky dark and bright at the same time. Willem van de Velde the Younger painted it in about 1680, and it is called The Gust.
charles-ii-of-spain

A young king stands in a rich black suit with his hand on a table, looking out with a pale face. Juan Carreño de Miranda painted Charles II of Spain in about 1680, and he was the last Habsburg king of Spain.
eugenia-martinez-vallejo-desnuda

A five-year-old girl stands in a rich red dress in one portrait, and in this second version she is shown without it. Juan Carreño de Miranda painted her in about 1680, and she was a girl at the king's court who was brought there because of her unusual size.
the-cannon-shot
A warship fires a cannon while small boats tilt in a calm sea, with a billow of smoke. Willem van de Velde the Younger painted it in about 1680.
the-floating-feather

A white swan, a duck and other birds react to a feather that floats down onto the water. Melchior d'Hondecoeter painted it in about 1680, and a floating feather is a sign of this painter's charming wit.
view-on-the-amstel-from-amsteldijk
A river with boats and a wide, cloudy sky, with a small, tidy village along a dike. Jacob van Ruisdael painted it in about 1680.
walpole-immaculate-conception
Mary stands on a crescent moon, in a blue cloak, with her eyes to heaven, with a crowd of cherubs around her. Bartolomé Esteban Murillo painted it in about 1680.
charles-ii-in-armour
A pale king in a full suit of armor stands in front of a draped red cloth, with his helmet on a table. Juan Carreño de Miranda painted him in 1681.
ascanius-shooting-the-stag-of-sylvia
A young prince shoots a stag in a golden landscape, a tragic event that starts a war in the story. Claude Lorrain painted it in 1682, and the glowing countryside is the real star.
auto-da-fe-on-plaza-mayor-madrid

A huge crowd gathers in a big square decorated with banners and stands, for a public ceremony held by the Spanish Inquisition. Francisco Rizi painted it in 1683, and it is a record of a grim day in Madrid's history.
esther-and-mordecai
Queen Esther sits writing a letter while the wise Mordecai stands beside her, in the story of how the Jewish people were saved. Aert de Gelder, a student of Rembrandt, painted it in about 1685.
madonna-of-the-baldacchino
Mary and the baby Jesus sit under a canopy, with saints in front of them, in a flurry of bright colors. Luca Giordano painted it in about 1685, and he was known as the fastest painter in Italy.
hagar-in-the-desert
An angel appears to Hagar, who sits in the desert with her young son, and shows her a spring of water. Giambattista Pittoni painted it in about 1687.
michael-shen-fu-tsung

A man in a long blue silk robe holds a cross, looking out calmly. Godfrey Kneller painted the Chinese visitor Michael Shen Fu-Tsung in 1687, when he came to England, and the king, James II, hung the painting in his bedroom.
adoration-of-the-shepherds-1688
Shepherds and angels gather around the glowing baby Jesus in a painted whirl of light. Luca Giordano painted it in 1688.
portrait-of-isaac-newton-1642-1727

A scientist with long, white hair in a plain brown robe looks out with a serious face. Godfrey Kneller painted Isaac Newton in 1689, when Newton was 46, a few years after he published his law of gravity.
the-adoration-of-the-shepherds
Shepherds kneel at the manger in a quiet scene, with warm light from the baby's face. Charles Le Brun painted it in about 1689.
the-avenue-at-middelharnis

A long, straight road goes down the middle of the picture between tall, thin trees, with a village, a farmer and a pair of walkers. Meindert Hobbema painted it in 1689, and it is his most famous picture.
ingenuity
A winged young man in a helmet glances back over his shoulder, glowing against a dark background. Giuseppe Maria Crespi painted this figure of Ingenuity in about 1690.
ten-thousand-miles-along-the-yellow-river

A giant, long scroll follows the Yellow River of China from its mountain source across hills, villages and farms, to the sea. It was painted in the late 1600s, and the scroll is more than 20 meters long.
selfportrait-with-allegories
A painter sits at a table with a palette and brushes, surrounded by symbols and allegorical figures. David Klöcker Ehrenstrahl, the royal painter in Sweden, painted it in about 1691.
the-marquise-de-seignelay-and-two-of-her-sons

A mother in a rich gown sits with two boys dressed as mythological figures, one as Cupid and one as a little child in a blue cloak. Pierre Mignard painted it in 1691, and it is a fancy, sweet picture.
the-defeat-of-sisera
A warrior falls from a chariot as a storm and a flood destroy his army. Luca Giordano painted it in about 1692, and the story is from the Bible.
portrait-of-armand-jean-le-bouthillier-de-rance
A monk with a thin face and a white robe looks out with a thoughtful expression. Hyacinthe Rigaud painted Abbot Rancé in 1696.
the-grote-markt-in-haarlem-with-the-st-bavo-church-seen

A big church with a huge tower stands over a market square in Haarlem, with tiny people walking and talking around it. Gerrit Berckheyde painted it in about 1696, and he painted many pictures of his home town.
portrait-of-john-locke

A philosopher in a black robe and a thin white collar looks out with a calm, level gaze. Godfrey Kneller painted John Locke in 1697, and Locke's ideas about freedom were later used in the American Declaration of Independence.
young-negro-with-a-bow
A young boy in a short tunic holds a bow, with a feathered cap on his head. Hyacinthe Rigaud painted it in about 1697, and the boy was probably a page at a European court.
antiochus-and-stratonice-bellucci

A prince lies sick in bed while a doctor feels his pulse and watches a young woman, who has made his heart race. Antonio Bellucci painted it in about 1700, and the story shows that the prince is lovesick.
bad-company
A group of rowdy people drink and flirt around a table in a tavern, while a boy peeks in. Jan Steen painted it in about 1670, and he often painted messy parties with a hidden lesson.
coronation-and-assumption-of-the-virgin
Mary is lifted up to heaven on a cloud, to be crowned by Christ, in a swirl of angels. Peter Paul Rubens painted it in about 1620.
diana-the-huntress-gentilesch
The goddess Diana in a hunting outfit, with a bow in her hand and a crescent moon in her hair, stands in the woods with her dogs. Orazio Gentileschi painted it in about 1630.
hikone-screen

A folding screen is painted with scenes of ladies and men at play in Kyoto, with music, games and gorgeous kimonos. An unknown artist painted it in about 1624, and it gives a lively view of life in Japan in the early Edo period.
mary-magdalene-tzanes

Mary Magdalene looks down thoughtfully, with a jar and a cross, in a painting in the Greek Orthodox tradition. Konstantinos Tzanes painted it in the 1600s, in Venice, where Greek artists mixed their style with Italian art.
melancholia

A woman in a blue dress sits with her head in her hand, in a mix of objects like a skull, a globe and books, with an angel above. Domenico Fetti painted it in about 1618, and the picture shows the thoughtful moods that people called melancholy.
portrait-of-don-garcia-ibanez-de-mugica-bracamonte
A man in black with a stiff collar and a sharp, gray beard looks out from the dark. El Greco painted it in about 1600.
portrait-of-infanta-isabella-clara-eugenia-as-nun

A woman in a nun's black and white habit looks out with a serious face. This painting is after Peter Paul Rubens, from the 1600s, and shows the ruler of the Spanish Netherlands, who became a nun after her husband died.
portrait-of-innocent-x

The pope sits in a red cap and robe, with a sharp, suspicious face and eyes that follow you. Diego Velázquez painted it in about 1650, and the pope said it was 'too true'. The 20th-century artist Francis Bacon painted many screaming versions of it.
portrait-of-paulus-van-beresteyn
A man in a black coat and a big white collar gazes at you with a clear, calm face. Frans Hals painted it in about 1620, and the lace of the collar is done with quick, brisk brushstrokes.
the-dream-of-saint-joseph
An angel with a hand on Joseph's shoulder speaks to him as he sleeps with his head on his hand, by candlelight. Georges de La Tour painted it in about 1640.
the-fall-of-man-poulakis
Adam and Eve stand under a tree in a garden with a snake, in the style of Greek painters influenced by Venice. Theodore Poulakis painted it in the 1600s.
moses-saved-from-the-waters
The princess of Egypt and her maids pull the baby Moses from the river in a basket, in a glowing landscape. Charles de La Fosse painted it in about 1701.
portrait-of-louis-xiv

The king of France stands in a huge, flowing blue cloak with fleur-de-lis, in white stockings with red heels, with his crown, scepter and sword beside him. Hyacinthe Rigaud painted it in 1701, when Louis was 63, and he looks grand and proud.
the-battle-of-vigo-bay-october-12-1702
English and Dutch ships fight Spanish and French ships in a smoky bay, with sails and flames. Ludolf Bakhuizen painted it in about 1702.
the-beautiful-strasbourgian
A young woman from Strasbourg wears a traditional black cap with a big bow and a fancy dress, and looks calmly at us. Nicolas de Largillière painted it in 1703.
diana-and-endymion
The goddess Diana comes down from the sky to look at a sleeping shepherd, Endymion, whom she loves. Francesco Solimena painted it in about 1705.
the-country-dance
Villagers dance and play music in the countryside, in a lively, early work by Watteau. He painted it in about 1706, and it was before he created his dreamy garden parties.
portrait-of-the-duke-of-antin
A young man in a red coat with a gold border and a big wig looks out with a confident smile. Hyacinthe Rigaud painted the Duke of Antin in about 1708.
amor-and-psyche-crespiego
The god of love, Cupid, and the girl Psyche are shown together in a tender moment. Giuseppe Maria Crespi painted it in about 1709, from an ancient myth.
actors-of-the-comedie-francaise
Actors in costumes stand on a stage, performing a scene in the French theater. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1710.
cat-among-roosters
A cat creeps in among a flock of roosters, hens and a duck, and the birds squawk and flutter. Jakob Bogdani painted it in about 1710, and the feathers are painted in every color.
spencer-compton-earl-of-wilmington
A man in a long wig and a red coat looks directly at us in an official portrait. Godfrey Kneller painted the Earl of Wilmington in about 1710.
woman-searching-for-fleas
A woman sits near a window, in a dim room, looking for fleas in her dress. Giuseppe Maria Crespi painted it in about 1710, and it was a common household chore.
marriage-contract-and-country-dancing
A wedding party takes place outdoors, with dancers, musicians and guests under big trees. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1711.
the-dreamer
A man in an oriental-looking robe and turban leans back in thought with a distant gaze. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1713, and the exotic costume was fashionable in Paris at the time.
pastoral-pleasure
Elegant couples relax in a shady park, with music and a picnic and a summer glow. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1714, and it is an example of the fête galante, a picture of a garden party.
abraham-s-sacrifice-of-isaac
Abraham raises a knife over his son Isaac, as an angel stops his arm just in time. Federico Benković painted it in about 1715.
an-embarrasing-proposal
A man in a velvet coat leans in to talk to a woman who looks embarrassed, as other couples stand nearby. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1715, and it is a funny little drama.
cupid-disarmed
The little god of love, Cupid, has been stripped of his bow and arrows by a young woman, in a round picture full of soft pink and blue. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1715.
the-chord
A group of musicians and ladies gather round, and one man tunes a guitar in the evening glow. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1715, and the picture is about the harmony between people.
the-worried-lover
A young man in a hat looks up at a window while he plays a guitar, with a sad look on his face. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1715.
a-vase-of-flowers

A gorgeous, big vase of tulips, roses and peonies stands on a ledge, with butterflies and a snail. Margaretha Haverman painted it in 1716, and she was one of the first women to be admitted to the French Academy.
nymph-and-satyr
A goat-legged satyr pulls the cloth off a sleeping nymph, in a woodland glade. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1716.
savoyard-with-a-marmot

A boy from the mountains of Savoy, in a patched coat, holds a little marmot on a leash and a box on his chest. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1716, and the boys went to Paris to earn money by showing animals.
the-death-of-sophonisbe
A queen in a rich dress takes a cup of poison, with tears and servants around her. Giambattista Pittoni painted it in about 1716.
the-two-cousins
Two cousins sit in a park, one holding a hat and looking at a visitor, as two couples chat in the background. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1716.
l-indifferent
A young man in a pink satin suit dances across a stage with a graceful, light step, as if he were floating. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1717, and he is about 25 centimeters high.
mezzetin
A man in a striped satin suit and a flat cap plays a guitar in the garden, looking sad. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted Mezzetin in about 1717, and he is a stock character from Italian street comedy.
polish-woman
A woman in a long, fur-trimmed coat and a tall fur hat looks out. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted this exotic costume in about 1717.
the-embarkation-for-cythera

Couples in fancy clothes get ready to leave the island of Cythera, the island of love, with cupids fluttering overhead and a golden boat waiting. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in 1717, and it made him famous.
the-faux-pas
A woman with a bold, flirtatious look sits on a bench, as a man bends toward her, in a garden. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1717.
the-shepherds
Elegant young men and women dressed as shepherds and shepherdesses dance in a sunny meadow. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1717, and it is a dreamlike, pretty picture.
la-boudeuse
A young woman in a pale silk dress sulks on a bench with her back to her partner, in a garden. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1718, and the title means 'the sulker'.
pierrot

A tall, sad clown in a loose white suit stands in front of a group of other actors, with his arms hanging down. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1718, and it is one of the best-loved pictures of the 1700s.
the-surprise
A pair of lovers in satin are surprised by a man in a harlequin costume, in a woodland. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1718.
fetes-venitiennes
Couples dance and chat in a park by a statue of a nymph, as a man plays the bagpipes. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1719, and one of the dancers is his friend.
l-accord-parfait
A group of lovers in a park flirt and play music together, under tall trees. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in about 1719.
scipio-africanus-freeing-massiva
A Roman general frees a young prince, and the prince's family kneels to thank him in a grand tent. Giovanni Battista Tiepolo painted it in about 1719, when he was young.
africa

A woman in a headdress and bright dress represents the continent of Africa, in a soft pastel. Rosalba Carriera painted it in about 1720, one of four pictures for the continents, and she was a famous Venetian pastel artist.
bacchus-and-ariadne-pittoni
The god Bacchus, with a wreath of leaves, meets the princess Ariadne on a beach, with a crowd of cheerful followers. Giambattista Pittoni painted it in about 1720.
the-molo-seen-from-the-bacino-di-san-marco
The waterfront of Venice sparkles in the sun, with the Doge's Palace, boats and the column of Saint Mark. Canaletto painted it in about 1720, and he was the great painter of Venice's views.
the-shop-sign-of-gersaint

Customers in a Paris art dealer's shop look at paintings, a mirror and a portrait of the king being packed into a crate. Jean-Antoine Watteau painted it in 1720 in just about a week, as a sign for a friend's shop, and it is full of charm.
the-martyrdom-of-saint-bartholomeo
Saint Bartholomew is pulled up by ropes with a twisting body, as soldiers prepare for his death. Giovanni Battista Tiepolo painted it in about 1722.
the-alarm
A man in bed hears a noise and reaches for his sword while a woman sits up in alarm, in a rich room. Jean-François de Troy painted it in 1723, as part of a pair of picture stories.
the-family-of-philip-v-ranc
The king and queen of Spain stand with their children in a big room, in rich clothes. Jean Ranc painted it in about 1723.
the-grand-canal-from-san-vio-venice
Gondolas glide down the Grand Canal under a bright sky, with palaces on both sides. Canaletto painted it in about 1723.
the-piazza-san-marco-in-venice
A huge crowd walks across the square in front of the basilica of Saint Mark, with its domes and bell tower. Canaletto painted it in about 1723, and he made views of the city for tourists.
bathsheba-at-her-bath-ricci
Bathsheba sits beside her bath, with her maids, and looks up at a letter from the king. Sebastiano Ricci painted it in about 1724.
the-garter
A young woman in a long satin gown ties a garter on her leg, with her maid, while a man is shown the way out. Jean-François de Troy painted it in 1724.
the-madonna-of-carmel-and-the-souls-of-the-purgatory
Mary appears in the clouds and sends angels to help the souls in purgatory below, who reach up to her. Giovanni Battista Tiepolo painted it in about 1724.
apelles-painting-campaspe

The ancient Greek painter Apelles, with a brush in hand, paints a portrait of Campaspe, who was a beautiful woman from the court of Alexander the Great. Giovanni Battista Tiepolo painted it in about 1725.
apotheosis-of-saint-sebastian
Saint Sebastian is lifted to heaven, with a gaggle of angels surrounding him. Sebastiano Ricci painted it in about 1725.
the-rape-of-europa-tiepolo
A young woman sits on the back of a white bull, who is the god Jupiter in disguise, as her maids wave and cry. Giovanni Battista Tiepolo painted it in about 1725.
the-rest-on-the-flight-into-egypt
Mary and the baby Jesus rest under a tree, while Joseph and a donkey stand by. Giambattista Pittoni painted it in about 1725.
the-stonemason-s-yard
Workers cut and carry stones beside a canal in Venice, near a church, under a pale sky. Canaletto painted it in about 1725, and it is one of his most appealing pictures of everyday life.
